text:
Pavel Mintyukov scored twice, added an assist and earned a Gordie Howe hat trick in Edmonton on Nov. 5. The Ducks have won four straight since he came back from a stretch out of the lineup, and he's playing his best hockey of the season: 6 points in 13 games, all of them in his last ten.

Be careful with the goals. He has 2 on 1.08 expected and is shooting 18.2%, against a range we'd put between 6% and 10%. The more interesting signs are the minutes, up to 25 in Calgary, and Evolving-Hockey's note from last season that he was better than his goals: 0.7 expected wins against -0.8 actual.

The defense is still the open question. Anaheim takes 46% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice at five on five, and last season Evolving-Hockey had opponents getting more chances with him out there, bottom 11% among defensemen. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking does credit him with clean exits (52% with possession). At 22, a 2022 10th overall pick, there's still time for the rest to come. We project about 29 points.
headline: Mintyukov's Gordie Howe night
